premise: The wind blows Butterfly away from Flower; Deer lets her ride on his nose and walks her slowly all the way back.
inspiration: The folk tale of the leaf carried off by the wind, turned: a gentle giant carries the small one home against it.
lesson: Being big means you can carry someone small home.

en-US.title: Butterfly in the Wind
en-US.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.4} Butterfly loved to visit Flower {flower:pulse}. Every morning she landed on her petals and said hello. But today, {canvas:wind 0.8 16s} {sfx:gust} whoosh! A big wind came blowing through the meadow. [surprised] Butterfly {butterfly:spin} tumbled up, up and away, over the grass and past the trees. [sad] Flower! she called. I can't get back! Deer {deer:pulse} was standing at the edge of the meadow. [softly] Land on my nose, he said. Hold on tight. So Butterfly held on. And Deer walked, very slowly, very carefully, into the wind. Step… by… step, all the way back across the meadow. When the wind had gone, Deer bent his head down low, till his nose touched Flower. [happily] Hello, said Butterfly. {flower:hearts} {butterfly:hearts} I came the long way round. {deer:glow}

es-ES.title: Mariposa y el viento
es-ES.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.4} A Mariposa le encantaba visitar a Flor {flower:pulse}. Cada mañana se posaba en sus pétalos y le decía hola. Pero hoy, {canvas:wind 0.8 16s} {sfx:gust} ¡fiuuu! Un viento fuerte entró soplando en el prado. [surprised] Mariposa {butterfly:spin} salió volando, arriba, arriba, lejos, por encima de la hierba y más allá de los árboles. [sad] ¡Flor!, llamó. ¡No puedo volver! Ciervo {deer:pulse} estaba en la orilla del prado. [softly] Posa en mi nariz, le dijo. Agárrate fuerte. Y Mariposa se agarró. Ciervo caminó muy despacio, con mucho cuidado, contra el viento. Paso… a… paso, cruzando todo el prado. Cuando el viento se fue, Ciervo bajó la cabeza, muy bajito, hasta que su nariz tocó a Flor. [happily] Hola, dijo Mariposa. {flower:hearts} {butterfly:hearts} He venido por el camino largo. {deer:glow}

gust.prompt: a sudden soft gust of wind sweeping through a meadow of long grass
